name: decode serialized preference fixtures in multiple encodings
definition: load preference/constraint information from heterogeneous fixture files (pickle, base64, and plain text) and convert them into a workable structured form.
failure_mode: an undecoded fixture leaves the constraint set incomplete

name: design primers for site-directed mutagenesis with correct annealing/orientation/constraints
definition: Order forward/reverse primers whose annealing regions bind the correct template loci/orientation, encode a desired insert, and meet annealing-length and melting-temperature bounds.
failure_mode: A reversed or misordered binding site yields a wrong assembled fragment.

name: download a large dataset/splits from remote object storage
definition: Retrieve pandas parquet from an S3-style endpoint over network so the training set and split info are locally available for training and validation.
failure_mode: Endpoint unreachable, schema mismatch, or split availability.

name: download a pretrained model and tokenizer into a local cache for offline reuse
definition: Fetch a remote pretrained model (and its tokenizer) over the network into the standard local cache so a later local-only consumer loads it without re-downloading.
failure_mode: model or tokenizer assets are not persisted into a cacheable local location, or a later offline load re-downloads or cannot locate them.
